item.title: You can finally open any Markdown file in Obsidian
item.description:
If you’re a fan of Obsidian one of the things that has likely driven you nuts over the years is that your Markdown files had to be inside a “vault”… Well, no more!

After you download the latest installer (yes, this is annoying, but just do it) and run it you will now be able to use your OSs native “Open with” function to open that file in Obsidian so that you can take advantage of the powerful editor and viewer that Obsidian provides!
